cards.title: Modeling Within-Animal Plasma-Tissue Correlation
cards.claim: In serial sacrifice designs, plasma and tissue concentrations measured from the same animal at the same time point are correlated. The Bayesian model explicitly accounts for this by using a bivariate normal distribution for log-transformed concentrations, improving the precision of AUC ratio estimates compared to methods that treat them as independent.
conditions: Paired plasma and tissue samples are collected from the same individual animal at each time point.
In the source model, the precision matrix (inverse covariance) has a Wishart prior; the covariance matrix has the corresponding Inverse-Wishart prior.
required_inputs: Paired concentration data (C_plasma, C_tissue) for each animal at each time point.
limitations: The cited model uses a time-specific covariance matrix Sigma_j for each sampling time point j.
Requires sufficient data points to estimate the covariance matrix reliably.
cards.downstream_use: Accurate estimation of tissue-to-plasma partition coefficients (Kp) and their confidence intervals in preclinical drug distribution studies.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
